title: AP CSA Core & Exam Preparation
description: The bridge from knowing Java to solving AP CSA problems: tracing mastery, specification-driven implementation, the four FRQ types, MCQ strategy and error clinics, timed practice, and a full exam simulation — aligned to the revised (Fall 2025) AP CSA framework.
audience: Students who finished AP CSA Foundations (or know core Java) and want exam performance: reliable AP-style problem solving, code tracing under pressure, FRQ methodology, and timed practice before moving to full mock exams.
outcomes: Trace unfamiliar Java programs with state tables, frames, and dispatch reasoning
Implement methods and classes directly from specifications, honoring preconditions and edge cases
Solve the exam's four FRQ types with the eight-step workflow and partial-credit strategy
Apply MCQ strategy: prediction-first answering, trap recognition, and probe-based elimination
Master arrays, ArrayList, 2D arrays, strings, inheritance, and recursion at AP problem depth
Debug broken solutions by locating the first contract divergence and repairing minimally
Work at exam tempo with the two-pass sweep, post-set audits, and full simulations
Self-score against rubric behavior and target the biggest remaining loss
